messages:
elaine: FYI TechToday reached out asking for a 1-2 sentence quote on our new inference benchmark, needs it by EOD tomorrow. any issues?
max: fine by me. who signs off? maya or kevin?
devin: PR needs to review wording + embargo handling. @sophia?
sophia: I can draft a short quote. Maya is out in the morning so Kevin likely best for quick signoff.
adam: Kevin can definitely approve. keep it non-technical.
elaine: draft: 
```
"Redwood Inference is pleased to see recent independent benchmarks that reflect real-world throughput and latency tradeoffs. Our priority is predictable, production-grade inference that meets customer scale and latency needs."
```
max: nit: replace "recent independent benchmarks" -> "recent third-party benchmarks"? clearer.
sophia: updated in draft with that tweak. can we run legal check before sending?
press-bot: [automated] running PR legal checklist...
press-bot: [automated] checks complete: no red flags. ok to provide.
adam: pinged Kevin for signoff.
kevin: approving the quote. one tiny edit: change "meets customer scale and latency needs" -> "meets customer scale and latency requirements"
sophia: applied Kevin's edit. final quote ready.
elaine: asking TechToday for a 24-hour heads-up before publish since they asked for early copy. sending with offer of a 15-min background call with product (press@redwood.ai).
devin: can we also add internal tracker link? added to tracker: https://drive.google.com/abc123 (internal)
elaine: sent DM to reporter. closing unless objections. :thumbsup:
max: :thumbsup:
sophia: :thumbsup:
